## How did you test it?

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Tried it in the app (browser `node bin/mixtape.js` or the desktop app)
- [ ] Checked English, 简体中文 and 日本語 if UI text changed (`public/i18n/zh.js`, `ja.js`)

## Checklist

- [ ] No API keys, tokens, personal data, music files or model weights are included
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed (`README.md`, `docs/`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under **Unreleased**
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (Mixtape is dependency-free on purpose; discuss first if you need one)
